required_concepts: Diagonals of a square are perpendicular
The diagonals intersect at right angles (90 degrees)
optional_concepts: Has 4 lines of symmetry that cut diagonally and in half
Square diagonals not shared by all rectangles is that they are perpendicular
All sides are equal and has 4 right angles
acceptable_paraphrases: Diagonals of a square are perpendicular to each other (they meet at 90°)
critical_errors: Misstating that the diagonals bisect corners rather than being perpendicular
Incorrectly stating that all rectangles have perpendicular diagonals
Failing to mention the right angle intersection of diagonals
misconceptions: Diagonals bisect each other at an angle other than 90 degrees
The diagonals of a square are not the only diagonals with this property (e.g., rhombus also has this property)
grading_notes: Award full points for answers containing all required concepts and some optional ones. Deduct points for critical errors and misconceptions, but allow partial credit for acceptable paraphrases.
